text: かんばんって　ためになるね！

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you are talking about, like は. かんばんって = 'signs, well, they'.

patterns.name: 〜ためになる
patterns.explanation: ためになる is a set phrase saying something does you good or teaches you something. ためになる = 'is useful'.
